# SVJ

SVJ is a self-improvement platform for daily challenges, training, nutrition, progress tracking, community activity, and a 60-day commitment.

## Primary public page

- https://savaje-com.lovable.app/landing.html — product overview and entry point to the web app.

## Product facts

- SVJ supports web and Android use.
- The web app is available at https://savaje-com.lovable.app/.
- The Android APK is published at https://savaje-com.lovable.app/downloads/SVJ-latest.apk when that file is present.
- Privacy policy: https://savaje-com.lovable.app/privacy
- Terms: https://savaje-com.lovable.app/terms
